headline: Thinking of a Bathroom Renovation? Avoid These Common Pitfalls
articleBody: Getting ready to tackle a bathroom renovation is exciting, but there are a few common mistakes folks make that can turn a dream project into a headache. Let's make sure you steer clear of them! First, don't underestimate the budget. It's easy to get carried away with fancy fixtures, but setting a realistic budget and having a contingency fund is crucial. Unexpected issues, like discovering old plumbing problems, pop up more often than you'd think. Second, skipping the planning phase is a big no-no. You really want to solidify your layout and material choices before demolition begins. Constantly changing your mind mid-project can lead to delays and increased costs. Third, DIYing everything might seem like a money-saver, but some jobs, especially plumbing and electrical, truly need a professional touch. A licensed contractor ensures everything is up to code and safe. Fourth, neglecting proper ventilation can lead to mold and mildew issues down the road. Make sure you plan for an effective exhaust fan. Finally, don't overlook storage! Bathrooms accumulate a lot of stuff, so think about clever storage solutions early on.
